## F18.where-set — Where effort is set

Definition: Flag, setting, environment, command or UI. (lever class: effort)
- claude-code [supported, verified] Effort is set with the --effort flag for the current session and the /effort selector (a slider outside screen reader mode). Writing effortLevel to userSettings saves it as the default effort for the session's current model without changing the running session. The maxEffortLevel managed setting caps effort for every model or per model. | ev: E-claude-code-07046, E-claude-code-00122, E-claude-code-00291, E-claude-code-00137
- codex-cli [supported, verified] Set via the model_reasoning_effort key in config.toml, the /reasoning command for the current chat, the model and reasoning control in the ChatGPT desktop app, and the effort input of the GitHub action. | ev: E-codex-cli-00649, E-codex-cli-02084, E-codex-cli-01877, E-codex-cli-01654

## F18.thinking-budget-visibility — Thinking budget and visibility

Definition: Token budgets and whether reasoning is shown. (lever class: effort)
- claude-code [partial, verified] Extended thinking is on by default; thinking tokens bill as output tokens and the default budget can be tens of thousands of tokens per request depending on the model. Thinking is visible step-by-step reasoning, shown in gray italic text in the terminal. MAX_THINKING_TOKENS caps thinking tokens on fixed-budget models; effort levels control adaptive reasoning. | limit: The cap applies 'on models with a fixed thinking budget'; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADAPTIVE_THINKING 'Has no effect on Fable models, Sonnet 5 and later, or Opus 4.7 and' (quote ends there). | ev: E-claude-code-09459, E-claude-code-08012, E-claude-code-07503, E-claude-code-00095
